snippet.title: Lights On My Screen (Trailer)
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5278930

Lights On My Screen is a 2D adventure RPG set inside a video game. Help Kid navigate the colorful world, solve puzzles, talk to characters and fight (or don't fight) the enemies. And find the one who brought them to this world...

FEATURES
7 Bosses. Some may fight you, some may become your friends, some can only be defeated together.

6 Levels. Some are normal and some are weirder. Some are open and some are very linear.

5 Fountains. Throw a coin to come back!

4 Arrows. You will have to push them during the rhythm mini-game - don't say I didn't warn you.

3 Endings. The world reacts to your actions accordingly. Will you save the world? Or will you destroy everything on your way?

2 Friends. One plays the game and the other watches and talks.

1 Game. With fun characters, colorful art and great soundtrack. And it's yours to play! What are you waiting for?
